Treasury Operations — Counterparty & Dealer Exposure Limits

Interbank Money Market Limit
Maximum overnight call/notice money borrowing limit is capped at 100% of capital funds on a fortnight average basis.

Derivative Counterparty Exposure
Over-the-Counter (OTC) interest rate swap exposure to non-bank counterparties requires Credit Support Annex (CSA) collateral agreements.
